title: Futuristic underground mall
content: I recently had a dream where I entered what I thought was a gas station in the desert which ended up being a very large 2 floor place full of all of the future generations children (implied somehow?????) The mall part was underground down the escalator and was very high tech, similar if not even more than some features of Tokyo tech. One large Costco sized building with fluorescent lights, separated into mini spaces with self check out based on the store (Shell Gas Station, 7Eleven, grocery store etc) All the kids and teens made fun of me for not understand how it worked there (I’m 29 so this was funny to me), I started to think maybe I was in their high school cafeteria. I got an Arizona Iced Tea and headed back upstairs.
